## Page search (tool: search_pages)
Asks the local vision service for the pages that best match a question.
It fuses three signals: **how the page looks** (image embeddings of whole pages, drawing-sheet tiles and title blocks), **sheet / figure / chart numbers** (exact text from the title block or page), and **keywords**.
Returns refs like `file_id:page[:tile]` for look_at_pages. Runs on the Mac; nothing leaves it.
